baseline.name: Forward merge with copied first input
baseline.approach: Copy nums1's m live values into a temporary array, then merge forward into nums1.

why: Writing from the end protects unread nums1 values and removes the need for the temporary copy.
quantitative_comparison: The archive avoids copying and storing m temporary integers while retaining linear merge work. The baseline and archive have equal time-growth order; no measured faster percentage is established.
tradeoffs: Requires at least m+n destination slots and valid sorted inputs; supplied capacity parameters are trusted rather than checked.
evidence_basis: Static pointer/write-direction and storage analysis; no benchmark.
